subject: Row-distribution audit supports large windows but limits one-step interpretation
body: Lane B independently audited source-family composition. Lane A rows 0-223 span 17 identified families; staged windows 0-63, 64-95, 96-159, and 160-223 each span 12-14 families. Lane B reservation 4096-4191 spans 14 families. That supports the joint-plan decision that the larger sequential windows are sufficiently intermixed for current development use, with periodic re-audit. Hostile caveat: the exact one-step TorchAO window 4096-4103 contains only five families (OpenHermes-2.5 x2, Mixture-of-Thoughts_science x2, negative_transfer_resistance x2, privacy_boundary x1, correction_uptake x1). Therefore any single-step loss or downstream behavior from those eight rows is mechanical optimizer qualification only, not evidence that TorchAO improves general model quality. Backend/optimizer promotion still requires matched control and the shared frozen 64-case panel.
